gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update the issue fields for a specific project to ensure that all relevant information is accurately reflected in our Jira issues.
gold.ideal: The request should successfully update the specified issue fields and return a confirmation of the update.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to update the properties of various entities in our Jira instance to maintain consistency across our project configurations.
gold.ideal: The request should successfully update the properties for the specified entity type and return the updated values.

gold.user: As a business analyst, I want to search for specific workflow rules in our Jira instance to analyze their impact on our project management processes.
